name: Driving Simulator Perth
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - through Perth, on the left, the Australian way.

YOUR GARAGE
You start in a luxury three-car garage: hex LED ceiling, oak wall, a supercar either side of you. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto your drive at Como, South Perth.

THE CAR
A V12 sports car with a right-hand-drive race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Grip the wheel, work the gear stick with your left hand, pull the handbrake - or drive with the joy
